data.name: Aether FIR ATC Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Aether FIR ATC Simulator

Take control of the airspace in Aether FIR ATC Simulator, a minimalist yet highly interactive Air Traffic Control (ATC) simulator. Your mission is simple but unforgiving: safely guide aircraft through your sector, manage their altitudes, speeds, and headings, and prevent mid-air collisions.

Key Features:

  • Deep ATC Mechanics: Issue direct commands via the Track Data Block (TDB). Change Clearances for Flight Levels (CFL), assign specific headings (vectoring), adjust speeds, and set climb/descent rates.

  • Multiple Game Modes:

    • Open Sector (Sim): An endless sandbox mode. Manage a continuous, randomized flow of arrivals, departures, and overflights.

    • Campaign: Hand-crafted scenarios with specific challenges. Face strict separation rules where a single mistake means game over.

    • Interactive Training: Learn the ropes with a comprehensive, step-by-step tutorial.

  • Advanced Controller Tools: Utilize the Extended Label Window (ELW) for flight plan details, dynamic measuring rulers, and predictive speed vectors.

  • Pre-clearances: Plan ahead by issuing conditional commands to uncontrolled aircraft before they cross your boundaries.

  • STCA System: A built-in Short Term Conflict Alert actively monitors the airspace and warns you when aircraft breach minimum separation limits (5 NM / 1,000 FT).

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics with WebGL support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard
